title: A gentle entry into lineage work
intro: You can begin with a name, a family story, a photograph, or simply a feeling of being called back.

sections.heading: Bring what you know
sections.body: The gaps in a family story can be part of the conversation too.

sections.heading: Keep the present visible
sections.body: Ancestral reflection should support your life now.

sections.heading: Make a living gesture
sections.body: Choose a value or practice you want to carry forward.
